_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: connectors
constraints: CHECK((vehicle IS NOT NULL AND implement IS NULL) OR (vehicle IS NULL AND implement IS NOT NULL))

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "partfields" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "parent_field" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES partfields (id), "name" TEXT NULL, "area" REAL NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "partfield" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES partfields (id), "work_started_at" TEXT NULL, "work_ended_at" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vehicles" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "geometry" TEXT NOT NULL, "gnss_antenna_config" TEXT NULL, "imu_config" TEXT NULL, "was_config" TEXT NULL, "steering_hardware_config" TEXT NULL, "thresholds" TEXT NULL, "path_tracking_parameters" TEXT NULL, "color_scheme" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "implements" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "connectors" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "vehicle" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES vehicles (id), "implement" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES implements (id), "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "relation" TEXT NOT NULL, "longitudinal_offset_from_ref" REAL NOT NULL, "lateral_offset_from_ref" REAL NOT NULL, "vertical_offset_from_ref" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "angle" REAL NOT NULL, CHECK((vehicle IS NOT NULL AND implement IS NULL) OR (vehicle IS NULL AND implement IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "connections" ("task" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "parent_connector" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES connectors (id), "child_connector" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES connectors (id), PRIMARY KEY ("task", "parent_connector", "child_connector")) WITHOUT ROWID;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "polygons" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "guidance_groups" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NULL, "border_polygon" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES polygons (id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "guidance_allocations" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "task" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "guidance_group" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES guidance_groups (id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "line_strings" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "width" INTEGER NULL, "length" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "guidance_patterns" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "line_string" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES line_strings (id), "border_polygon" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES polygons (id), "type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "heading" REAL NULL, "radius" INTEGER NULL, "options" INTEGER NULL, "propagation_direction" INTEGER NULL, "extension" INTEGER NULL, "number_of_swaths_left" INTEGER NULL, "number_of_swaths_right" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "guidance_group_patterns" ("guidance_group" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES guidance_groups (id), "guidance_pattern" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES guidance_patterns (id), PRIMARY KEY ("guidance_group", "guidance_pattern")) WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "points" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "latitude" REAL NOT NULL, "longitude" REAL NOT NULL, "elevation" REAL NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "line_string_points" ("line_string" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES line_strings (id), "point" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES points (id), PRIMARY KEY ("line_string", "point")) WITHOUT ROWID;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "links" ("table_ref" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "link_value" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("table_ref", "ref_id")) WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "partfield_guidance_groups" ("partfield" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES partfields (id), "guidance_group" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES guidance_groups (id), PRIMARY KEY ("partfield", "guidance_group")) WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "partfield_polygons" ("partfield" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES partfields (id), "polygon" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES polygons (id), PRIMARY KEY ("partfield", "polygon")) WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "partfield_line_strings" ("partfield" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES partfields (id), "line_string" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES line_strings (id), PRIMARY KEY ("partfield", "line_string")) WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "partfield_points" ("partfield" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES partfields (id), "point" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES points (id), PRIMARY KEY ("partfield", "point")) WITHOUT ROWID;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "polygon_line_strings" ("polygon" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES polygons (id), "line_string" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES line_strings (id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sections" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "implement" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES implements (id), "longitudinal_offset" REAL NOT NULL, "lateral_offset" REAL NOT NULL, "width" REAL NOT NULL, "working_width" REAL NOT NULL, "length" REAL NOT NULL, "automate_activation" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("automate_activation" IN (0, 1)), "color" TEXT NULL, "worked_path_color" TEXT NULL);
